questions.q: How many times does AWS hand back the private half of a newly created key pair?
options: Exactly once, in the create-key-pair API response
Every time you call describe-key-pairs
Twice — once at creation and once at first launch
AWS never returns the private key at all
questions.explain: AWS keeps the public key and installs it on the instance, but the private key is returned only once — if you lose it, there's no recovery.

questions.q: What is the default inbound behavior of a brand-new security group?
options: All inbound traffic is denied until a rule explicitly allows it
All inbound traffic is allowed until a rule explicitly denies it
Only port 22 is open by default
Inbound rules only take effect after a reboot
questions.explain: Security groups work entirely on allow rules — nothing inbound is permitted until you add a rule for it.

questions.q: What does it mean that a security group is "stateful"?
options: Response traffic to an already-allowed request is automatically permitted, with no matching rule needed
The security group remembers every IP that has ever connected, forever
Rules only apply during business hours
The security group automatically updates itself based on traffic patterns
questions.explain: If inbound traffic on a port is allowed, the return traffic is automatically permitted — you don't need a matching outbound rule, unlike stateless network ACLs.

questions.q: In ssh -i my-ec2-keypair.pem ec2-user@203.0.113.50, what does -i do?
options: Points the SSH client at the private key file to authenticate with
Specifies the instance ID to connect to
Tells SSH to ignore the security group rules
Sets the region the instance is running in
questions.explain: -i tells the ssh command which private key file to use for authentication against the public key installed on the instance.

questions.q: An SSH connection to a running instance fails. Which two causes does the lesson say are most common?
options: The security group doesn't allow the current IP on port 22, or the wrong username was used for the AMI
The instance's AMI is corrupted and must be rebuilt
The VPC was deleted after the instance launched
The private key file was never chmod 400'd on Windows
questions.explain: A blocked security group rule or using the wrong default username (ec2-user vs. ubuntu, depending on the AMI) account for most failed SSH connections.
